secondTenant.$comment: Used by the tenant tests (PAR-03, FLW-52/53); slug and name come from helpers/fixtures.ts. catalog.$comment: Seeded process catalog (M8F-677). Every process is a template: one folder each in e2e/seed/catalog/templates/<key>/ (diagrams the app must refuse, used by the upload guard tests, are in e2e/seed/catalog/refused/) (generated by e2e/seed/tools/build_catalog.py), holding the diagram, its forms and decision table, and paths.json (the routes through it). The seed imports each folder as template e2e-<key> (a new version when its files change), creates the model listed below from it, keeps the model's files exactly like the folder and gives it its status (draft, published or paused; one model is kept paused to check that state). run-seeded-processes.spec.ts runs every route in paths.json on the seeded models; e2e/seed/tools/validate_catalog.py checks the same routes on the engine without the app. Tests that only run a process use the seeded model itself and delete their instances; the flow-* templates (small approval and task processes) have no seeded model: the process-flow and run specs (e2e-flow*.spec.ts, run-*.spec.ts) create their own model from them in a group of their own and delete it afterwards (useFlowCatalog); modeler specs, which save changes, work on a copy that is deleted afterwards (useSeededModelCopy).

connectorProfiles.$comment: The postgres steps in the templates use this profile. A DoSQL profile lets every process of the tenant run SQL with its credentials, so: M8FLOW_E2E_PG_DSN when set (use a database user that may only touch the e2e_* tables); otherwise only on a local or CI stack, from POSTGRES_USER / POSTGRES_PASSWORD / POSTGRES_DB in the repository .env (no built-in defaults). Anywhere else the profile is not created and the routes with a postgres step are skipped. Host m8flow-db is the database as the connector proxy sees it.
connectorProfiles.description: Stack database used by the E2E seed catalog templates
